remediation.summary: Correct or remove every sampled broken href, preserve intentional redirects, and rerun the same link policy without increasing its failure allowance.
technicalHints: HEAD 405/501 responses are recorded as unsupported rather than broken; verify those endpoints manually or make their HEAD behavior standards-compatible.
